info.title: Ferry Staff API
info.description: Existing read-only backend contract. Display payload schemaVersion remains 11. Additive properties are allowed; clients must tolerate unknown fields. Schedule IDs are opaque strings. Timestamps are UTC ISO-8601, service dates use meta.timezone, and schedule seconds may exceed 86400. /api/override has been removed.

seconds.description: Seconds since local service-day midnight; may exceed 86400.

id.description: Stable fleet ID or nycf: provider vehicle ID; never a feed entity ID.

confirmedAt.description: Observation timestamp in Unix epoch milliseconds; confirms assignment, not actual arrival.
